content: Almost everything with high-end memory or storage is more expensive these days, and tablets are no exception, so we’re glad to see that Amazon and Best Buy have the most recent 11-inch iPad Air with the M4 chip on sale for $649. That’s $100 lower than the new retail price that went into effect (alongside plenty of other Apple price hikes) in June. You can also grab the 256GB model for $749 (usually $849), and the version with a cellular antenna for $799 (usually $899). [Product: Apple iPad Air M4 | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-iPad-Air-11-inch-M4/dp/B0GQVLBM3T?th=1&tag=theverge02-20, https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fapple-11-inch-ipad-air-m4-chip-wi-fi-128gb-space-gray%2FJJGCQYCTW2%2Fsku%2F6586895, https://www.amazon.com/Apple-iPad-Air-11-inch-M4/dp/B0GQVPN5KR?tag=theverge02-20] We reviewed the M4 iPad Air when it released in March, and found a very similar experience to the previous generation, for better or worse. The upgraded internals give the system a performance boost and better connectivity, like Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, but otherwise this update is short on notable or exciting features if you’ve used an iPad Air the past few years. Read our Apple iPad M4 Air review. Other deals to consider * The Garmin InReach Mini 2 is discounted to $249.99 at a variety of retailers, including Amazon, REI, and directly from Garmin. This compact device uses a satellite connection, which requires a Garmin InReach subscription, to provide emergency services, location sharing, and even text messaging when paired with smart device. * Best Buy has the Anker 140W 4-Port Laptop Charger on sale for $55.99, a $24 discount off the usual price. With three USB-C ports and a USB-A port mounted on its bottom to prevent sagging in your outlet with multiple devices plugged in, you can easily charge a weekend worth of devices. The built-in display lets you check your total power usage at a glance, or make sure you’re charging at the right power level. * Amazon is selling the Marshall Stanmore III Bluetooth speaker for $199.99, half off the usual retail price and matching the lowest price to date. While it doesn’t have a phono pre-amp, it does have RCA inputs for use with a properly-equipped record player, and vintage amplifier styling that helps set it apart from the crowd of other speakers.
chineseTitle: 以 6 月涨价以来的最低价格购买 iPad Air M4
chineseSummary: 如今，几乎所有配备高端内存或存储的产品都更加昂贵，平板电脑也不例外，因此我们很高兴看到亚马逊和百思买以 649 美元的价格出售最新的配备 M4 芯片的 11 英寸 iPad Air。这比生效的新零售价低 100 美元（同时 [...]
chineseContent: 如今，几乎所有配备高端内存或存储的产品都更加昂贵，平板电脑也不例外，因此我们很高兴看到亚马逊和百思买以 649 美元的价格出售最新的配备 M4 芯片的 11 英寸 iPad Air。这比 6 月份生效的新零售价（以及苹果其他许多涨价举措）低了 100 美元。您还可以花 749 美元（通常是 849 美元）购买 256GB 型号，带蜂窝天线的版本售价 799 美元（通常是 899 美元）。 [产品：苹果iPad Air M4 | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-iPad-Air-11-inch-M4/dp/B0GQVLBM3T?th=1&tag=theverge02-20， https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fapple-11-inch-ipad-air-m4-chip-wi-fi-128gb-space-gray%2FJJGCQYCTW2%2Fsku%2F6586895， https://www.amazon.com/Apple-iPad-Air-11-inch-M4/dp/B0GQVPN5KR?tag=theverge02-20] 我们在 3 月份发布的 M4 iPad Air 上进行了评测，发现无论好坏，它的体验与上一代非常相似。升级后的内部结构为系统带来了性能提升和更好的连接性，例如 Wi-Fi 7 和蓝牙 6，但如果您在过去几年使用过 iPad Air，那么这次更新缺乏值得注意或令人兴奋的功能。阅读我们的 Apple iPad M4 Air 评论。其他值得考虑的优惠 * Garmin InReach Mini 2 在亚马逊、REI 等多家零售商处折扣至 249.99 美元，也可直接从 Garmin 购买。这款紧凑型设备使用卫星连接，需要订阅 Garmin InReach，才能提供紧急服务、位置共享，甚至在与智能设备配对时提供短信。 * Best Buy 现有 Anker 140W 4 端口笔记本电脑充电器促销，售价 55.99 美元，比平常价格折扣 24 美元。底部装有三个 USB-C 端口和一个 USB-A 端口，可防止设备下垂
